run_release_docs: run release_docs.py with a version number to branch Google Test wiki pages for a new release
create_WikiBrancher: create a WikiBrancher instance with a dot version string to prepare wiki file branching
branch_WikiBrancher_BranchFiles: branch wiki files using WikiBrancher.BranchFiles to create SVN copies with a version prefix
update_WikiBrancher_UpdateLinksInBranche: update internal wiki links in branched files using WikiBrancher.UpdateLinksInBranchedFiles
summarize_DropWikiSuffix: summarize the DropWikiSuffix function which removes the .wiki suffix from a filename
